speaker: thomas_nashe
text: The third cup. I had not meant to be quiet, and here I am quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Quiet is allowed. You have talked a shilling's worth.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: Kit, laughing in a garden at Scadbury. Two summers gone. He was laughing. The garden was a garden. That is the whole of what I am willing to set down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two summers. I have the laugh. You need not bring him any nearer than that.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: I will not. I am already somewhere else, and I am going there very fast. Ask me about the cup. Ask me whether Harvey can chew. Do not ask me the garden again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the cup. I would rather the cup than a story with a date nailed to it.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: No date. He laughed. The quiet is over. Hear the speed and take it for the end of the garden.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can hear it. Stay with the cup, if you must stay with something.

speaker: thomas_nashe
text: The cup, then. And the alderman's hand. And Harvey's last page, which is a worse garden than a real one because it has no gate to leave by.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The third cup is the last I am standing you. Talk as fast as you like inside it.
